profile.headline: Junior Web Developer
profile.summary:
During my time as a mathematics educator, I was led to web development when I discovered my passion for using logical thinking to resolve my own programming and data problems. I am constantly working to improve my ability in building web applications. As an avid learner, I keep my skills updated by studying developments in the field and expanding my fluency in an array of programming languages. Having been a teacher, I know first-hand the importance of communication and teamwork during collaboration with my peers to achieve set objectives. I look forward to being a part of a larger team, building on my dedication to web development, honing my abilities, and transitioning into a full-time role as a web developer.

• To learn more about me and my work go to  https://hieungocnguyen-portfolio.herokuapp.com
• Are you interested in working together? You can email me @ hnnguyen45@gmail.com

positions.title: Web Developer Intern
positions.description:
As an intern, I play an active role in both operational and programmatic support to Wilshire Financial Network. In this role I readily apply my research and web design knowledge to all aspects of digital marketing to generate leads for new clients/advertisers and drive traffic to the company website. Through application of WordPress, HTML, CSS and Javascript, I have built webpages for companies, relief funds, etc. using WordPress themes, plug-ins and widgets.  

Current Projects: 
Hurricane Relief
http://helphurricaneirmavictims-naples.org/ 

Novus Property Preservation
http://novuspreservation.com/

Cross Roads C.A.C.
http://www.crossroads-cac.org

Chase Buys Homes
http://chasebuyshomes.com

Wilshire Loaning Service
http://wilshireloanservicing.com

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description: With the Thinkful Online and Remote Coding Bootcamp, I completed requirements for the Full Stack Web Development course. I refined my skills as a web developer and applied those acquired skills by styling and creating dynamic functional applications through the principles of responsive web design. This was accomplished through utilization of server side frameworks and libraries.
